question: The _________ (ABDM) aims to develop the backbone necessary to support the integrated digital health infrastructure of the country.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM):**

 
 
• It was introduced in **September 2021.**
 
• It seeks to** advance healthcare digitization** and provide an open, interoperable National Digital Health Ecosystem.
